vo: You ask an AI a question.
shot: Hook close-up. A glowing orange question mark draws itself; the robot tilts its head, curious.
Robot taps Send on a glass chat window (ripple), the answer pours in, the robot hops in surprise.

vo: But it isn't pulling a finished reply from a file.
shot: A drawer slides open, a document rises, and a slate "no" ring draws over it. Robot shakes its head.

vo: It's predicting one, piece by piece.
shot: Large glass word tiles pop in one by one; an orange dashed slot pulses for the next piece.
Medium close-up, open-hand gesture, slow camera push-in.

vo: With popular AI chat apps, your message travels…
shot: Rotating dotted globe; a glowing data packet arcs across it.
Zoom into a server corridor; light streaks race along the floor.
Processor powers up; pulses flow along its circuit traces.

vo: First, your text is split into tokens…
shot: "How do rainbows form?" is scanned, then breaks into tiles; "rain|bows" glows orange; word, part-word and punctuation tiles pulse in turn.

vo: During training, the model learned patterns from huge amounts of text.
shot: Streams of light flow from a stack of pages into a glowing neural network.

vo: It doesn't look through that text when it answers.
shot: Streams cut; the pages dim behind a slate "no" ring. Robot thinks, hand to chin.

vo: The patterns are captured in billions of numbers.
shot: Camera dives into the network; it dissolves into a shimmering field of numbers.

vo: …to calculate which token is likely to come next.
shot: Unfinished sentence with an empty slot; probability bars grow (illustrative); "sunlight" wins.

vo: It picks one, adds it, and repeats, token by token…
shot: Tiles drop in faster and faster until the sentence is complete; an orange loop arrow spins.

vo: That's why AI sounds so fluent. But fluent isn't the same as correct.
shot: A polished answer types itself; a magnifier sweeps in and one line turns orange. Robot: surprised → confused → thinking.

vo: …it was built one prediction at a time. Check what matters.
shot: Robot explains confidently; an orange check mark pops onto the answer card; the robot nods.
End card: Ivo waves, an orange "Follow Ask Ivo" button pops in, then "for the next video" and the tagline.
